extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental), immanen-, surpass or overstep, in file order. Unsurpassable a priori (§§5, 8) and transcend in §20 are not the theme. No stratum is set, since the record does not separate the 1912 main text from the supplements.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-467): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: Soul-states are consciousness-experiences given adequately, without the intermediary of appearance, in the plane of immanent temporality.
units.quote: the soul-states are the “consciousness-experiences” that are adequately given themselves, without the intermediary of appearance, in the plane of immanent temporality

units.claim: Material thing, body and soul are determinate transcendencies constituting themselves in pure consciousness, and the absolute is won only by reduction to it.
units.quote: Material thing, body, soul — these are quite determinate and specific transcendencies, constituting themselves in pure consciousness for the pure I in their own way and fully understandably

units.claim: In transcendental experiencing all transcendent being is bracketed, and in its place remains the being-meant of the transcendent, the noemata.
units.quote: In transcendental experiencing, all “transcendent being” — understood in the normal sense as true being — is excluded, “bracketed.”

units.claim: Once phenomenological method is secure, methodologically permissible transgressions emerge that justify themselves within a suitably extended phenomenological immanence.
units.quote: there also emerge methodologically permissible transgressions that from a higher standpoint justify themselves within a suitably extended phenomenological immanence

units.claim: In the realizing apprehension immanent time becomes a manifestation of objective time, so the world of realities becomes a single world.
units.quote: Immanent time becomes a manifestation of objective time; the immanent “simultaneous” becomes a manifestation of the objective “simultaneous.”

absences.expected_because: Material thing and material perception open the work, and §12 counts the material thing among the transcendencies constituted in pure consciousness.
